gloss: to get heated; to become passionate; to warm up

definitions.gloss: to become warm; to heat up
definitions.explanation: Literally, to take on heat. Used for physical objects that become warm or hot.

definitions.gloss: to get heated; to become passionate or intense
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, used when a discussion, debate, competition, or atmosphere becomes more intense, passionate, or emotionally charged.

examples.japanese: パソコンが{熱|ねつ}を{帯|お}びてきた。
エンジンが{熱|ねつ}を{帯|お}びている。
{長時間|ちょうじかん}{使|つか}うとスマホが{熱|ねつ}を{帯|お}びることがある。
examples.english: If you use a smartphone for a long time, it can get hot.

examples.japanese: {議論|ぎろん}が{熱|ねつ}を{帯|お}びてきた。
{選挙|せんきょ}が{近|ちか}づくにつれ、{運動|うんどう}が{熱|ねつ}を{帯|お}びてきた。
examples.english: As the election approached, the campaign heated up.

examples.japanese: {優勝|ゆうしょう}をかけた{試合|しあい}は{終盤|しゅうばん}に{向|む}けて{熱|ねつ}を{帯|お}びていった。
examples.english: The championship game grew more intense heading into the final stretch.

notes:
The figurative sense (heated discussion/atmosphere) is more common in everyday use than the literal physical sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {議論|ぎろん}が{熱|ねつ}を{帯|お}びる — the argument heats up
- {戦|たたか}いが{熱|ねつ}を{帯|お}びる — the battle intensifies
- {雰囲気|ふんいき}が{熱|ねつ}を{帯|お}びる — the atmosphere gets heated

RELATED WORDS:
- {白熱|はくねつ}する — to become white-hot, intensify
- {盛|も}り{上|あ}がる — to get lively, heat up
- {帯|お}びる — to carry, to take on (a quality)
